sloka: अवश्यम् रक्षणम् कार्यमदृष्टे विजने वने ।अग्रतः गच्च सौमित्रे सीता त्वाम् अनुगच्चतु ॥२-५२-९५॥
transliteration: avaśyam rakṣaṇam kāryamadṛṣṭe vijane vane ।agrataḥ gacca saumitre sītā tvām anugaccatu ॥2-52-95॥

translations.english: In this desolate forest which we had never seen before we must certainly be concerned about our protection. O Lakshmana , let Sita follow you
